name: msos_implied_range_api_v1
title: MSOS Implied Range API v1

founderPriorityOverride.source: Engineering Operating System v1 / PPE #5501 / Autobuilder #202.
founderPriorityOverride.purpose: Expose a narrow reusable options-implied range primitive through the existing MSOS/PPE API stack without duplicating financial math or infrastructure.

productScope.summary: Add GET /v1/implied-range for BTC/ETH explicit expiry and optional strike probabilities, reusing the existing options-implied distribution producer.

acceptanceCriteria: GET /v1/implied-range accepts BTC or ETH, an explicit supported listed expiry, and an optional positive strike with deterministic machine-readable validation errors.
The implementation reuses existing Options Horizon / Options Market Read calculation and market-data/cache infrastructure; it does not create a second options pricing engine, producer, or cache.

Successful responses expose asset, expiry, as_of UTC, spot, implied_forward, atm_iv, median, p25, p75, one_sigma_low, one_sigma_high, quality status/flags, method, and an informational-only disclaimer.
When strike is supplied, probability_above and probability_below are each in [0,1] and sum to 1 within numerical tolerance.
Distribution ordering is coherent and missing/degraded/stale upstream data is represented honestly as degraded/unavailable rather than fabricated.
Known-good BTC and ETH fixtures, degraded-data fixture, unavailable-source fixture, schema tests, and numerical regression tests pass.
OpenAPI and direct HTTP documentation exist independently of Qatom; Qatom-specific marketplace/payment configuration is not required for direct endpoint tests.
Existing /v1/options-market-read and Options Horizon behavior remain backward compatible.

forbiddenPaths: Qatom application source or marketplace configuration
a second market-data producer or cache
